caption: The image is a drawing of a rectangular, reddish-brown wooden chest with two main sections framed by white swirling and looping border designs. The larger, upper section of the chest is decorated with symmetrical, ornate white floral patterns that include curved vines, leaves, and stylized flowers, with some green details on the leaves and flower petals, and a central white vase-like motif. The lower section is a drawer, similarly decorated with white swirling and floral patterns, along with a few green leaf accents. The left side of the chest also carries a white pattern, although the details are less visible from this angle. The chest stands on four short rectangular legs and the surface is plain, with no objects on top. The drawing is set against a plain off-white or cream background, and there is a signature reading "Lawrence Flynn" in black cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Chest (Front View)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
